D: Pongo and Perdita set out across England to rescue their puppies from Cruella De Vil.
P: Serve the snacks when the puppies settle in front of the TV for their favourite dog show.
S: Cream cheese spread on crackers and dotted with black olive pieces, laid out in rows like puppies.
the cows in the barn giving the puppies warm milk
Shortbread biscuits baked at 160C for 20 minutes until pale gold, served with small glasses of cold milk.
the puppies rolling in soot to disguise themselves
Potato chips fried thin and tossed with black sesame, smoked salt and a little charcoal-dark nori powder.
M: the little London flat by Regent's Park
Lamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, peas and stock, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Nanny looking after the house and the puppies
Beef topside roasted at 200C to medium, rested, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
W: Soft vanilla cookies baked at 180C for 12 minutes, iced half in vanilla glaze and half in chocolate glaze.
K: Roger and Anita's tea at home
English breakfast tea brewed strong in a pot, with milk and sugar on the side.

s.how: Spread 24 water crackers with cream cheese. Chop black olives into small pieces and dot them over each cracker like spots. Add a tiny snip of chive for a tail and lay them out in long rows on a platter like a litter of puppies.

s.note: the cows in the barn giving the puppies warm milk
s.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 300g plain flour and 50g rice flour. Press into a tin, prick all over and bake at 160C for 20 minutes until pale gold. Cut into fingers while warm. Serve with small glasses of cold milk.

m.note: the little London flat by Regent's Park
m.how: Brown 800g lamb mince with a diced onion and 2 grated carrots. Add a cup of peas and 250ml stock and simmer for 30 minutes until thick. Spread in a dish, top with buttery mash from 1kg potatoes and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and an egg, then mix in 300g self-raising flour and 125ml buttermilk. Spoon rounds onto trays and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Ice half of each with vanilla glaze and half with chocolate glaze made with cocoa.

d.note: Roger and Anita's tea at home
d.how: Warm a teapot with boiling water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and pour over a litre of freshly boiled water. Steep for 4 minutes until strong. Pour into cups and set milk and raw sugar on the side, the way Nanny would.
